title: I’m an indie developer working on a 3D diorama puzzle game called 3D Hobbyist — I’d love your honest feedback!
author: Careless_Ad5758
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I’m an indie game developer, and I’ve been working on a mobile game called 3D Hobbyist. I wanted to create something relaxing where you can build beautiful little 3D worlds piece by piece.

The game focuses on assembling 3D models and creating miniature dioramas, with different collections to explore, including architecture, animals, fantasy creatures, and sculptures.

As a solo indie developer, I’m constantly trying to improve the game, and I’d really appreciate some fresh eyes on it!

If you decide to give it a try, I’d love to hear your thoughts on:

🧩 How enjoyable and satisfying is the puzzle experience?

🎨 What do you think of the 3D models and visual style?

📱 How does the game feel on your device?

💡 What would you change, improve, or add?

Honest criticism is absolutely welcome! You don’t have to sugarcoat anything. Even small suggestions can help me make the game better.

Try 3D Hobbyist here: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.richardstudio.Hobbyist3D

comments.author: SlightOfHand_
comments.body: I think the puzzle solution is “Trex”
